x-m-el-econ-02.title: “Ragi 30% da ƙarin kupon 10%” rangwamen 40% ne?
x-m-el-econ-02.goal: Nemo kuma gyara kuskuren haɗa ragi masu biyo juna ta hanyar tara kaso kawai, sannan ƙirƙiri haɗin ragi naka da ke ba da farashi na ƙarshe iri ɗaya.
x-m-el-econ-02.material: Ana sayar da T-shirt mai farashin asali 50,000 won da ragi 30%. A wurin biya, ana amfani da kuponin “ƙarin rangwamen 10%” wanda ke ƙara rage 10% daga adadin kuɗin da za a biya a lokacin amfani da shi. A ƙasa ga yadda abokinka ya lissafa farashin ƙarshe.
x-m-el-econ-02.thinking.0: Nemo mataki na farko da ke da kuskure a warwarewar.
x-m-el-econ-02.thinking.1: Gyara kuskuren, sannan ka sake gina warwarewar.
x-m-el-econ-02.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da tushen lissafi yake sauyawa.
x-m-el-econ-02.prereq.0: Yadda ake nemo farashi ta amfani da kaso
x-m-el-econ-02.prereq.1: Bambance kashin rangwame da farashin bayan rangwame
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko mara daidai a warwarewar abokinka.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sake karanta adadin da matsalar ta ce kuponin yake rage kaso daga gare shi.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.hint.1: Daga sama, duba layi ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko adadin da aka samu ya yi daidai da bayanin matsalar.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.line.0: Ragin 30% daga farashin asali na 50,000 won yana ba da 50,000 × 0.7 = 35,000 won.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.line.1: Kuponin 10% ne, saboda haka yana ƙara rage 5,000 won, wato 10% na 50,000 won.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka da kuponin za ka iya sayen T-shirt ɗin da 30,000 won.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne farkon kuskuren. Kason 10% na kuponin ya shafi 35,000 won da aka rage farashi, ba farashin asali na 50,000 won ba. Saboda haka 35,000 × 0.9 = 31,500 won, kuma adadin 30,000 won a layukan 3 da 4 sakamakon ci gaba da wannan kuskure ne. (50,000 × 0.7 × 0.9 = 31,500 won)
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri haɗin rangwame biyu masu biyo juna da zai sa farashin ƙarshe ya zama 72% na farashin asali. Kason rangwamen farko a% ne, na biyu kuma b%; duka lambobi cikakku ne daga 1 zuwa 99. Idan aka musanya tsarin a da b, ana ƙirga su a matsayin haɗi ɗaya. Shigar da haɗi daban-daban guda 2.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka tantance kashin farashin asali da ya rage bayan rangwamen farko, sannan ka yi tunanin abin da zai rage bayan na biyu.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta abin da (100−a) aka ninka da (100−b) zai zama daidai da shi.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.hint.2: Tun da (100−a)(100−b)=7200, da zarar ka zaɓi a, za a iya tantance b. Zaɓi wasu ƙimomi na a ka nemo b.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukansu lambobi cikakku ne daga 1 zuwa 99.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole a da b su zama lambobi cikakku daga 1 zuwa 99.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Farashin ƙarshe ya zama 72% na farashin asali.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Farashin ƙarshe bai zama 72% na farashin asali ba. Duba ko (1−a/100)×(1−b/100) ya yi daidai da 0.72.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.explain: 20% da 10%: 0.8 × 0.9 = 0.72. 25% da 4%: 0.75 × 0.96 = 0.72. Waɗannan su ne kawai haɗin lambobi cikakku guda biyu (ba a ƙirga haɗin da ya bambanta ta tsarin ragi kaɗai ba). Jimillar kaso biyu na rangwamen (30, 29) ta bambanta da rangwamen jimilla na 28%.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin haɗin da ka ƙirƙira, ka bayyana dalilin da jimillar rangwamen yake 28% duk da cewa jimillar kaso biyun ba 28% ba ce.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta layi guda ga kowane sauyi, kana nuna yadda farashin ya sauya daga wani adadi zuwa wani.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Da farko ka faɗi adadin da rangwamen na biyu yake bisa shi.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Bayani naka ya ƙunshi jerin farashi takamaimai (kamar 100 won → 80 won → 72 won)?
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ya nuna cewa ana lissafa rangwamen a kan farashin da aka riga aka rage, ba farashin asali ba?
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Yin rangwamen 20% sannan 10% yana haɗuwa ya zama 30%, amma kason 10% na biyu yana aiki ne a kan farashin da ya riga ya sauka zuwa 80 won, saboda haka yana rage 8 won kaɗai. Bisa farashin asali na 100 won, rangwamen shi ne 20 + 8 = 28 won, wato 28%.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Rangwamen na biyu ya dogara da adadin bayan an yi rangwame, ba farashin asali ba; saboda haka yana rage ƙasa da 10% na farashin asali. Shi ya sa jimillar rangwamen ta fi ƙaramin jimillar kaso biyu.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Ana ninka kashin rangwamen na biyu da adadin da ya rage bayan na farko, saboda haka ba a tara kaso biyun kai tsaye.

x-m-el-econ-03.title: Canjin kuɗi: wane wuri ne ya fi bayarwa?
x-m-el-econ-03.goal: Kafin kwatanta ofisoshin canjin kuɗi guda biyu, tantance sauran bayanan da ake buƙata, sannan nemo iyakar ƙimar lambar da ba a bayar ba inda sakamakon zai sauya.
x-m-el-econ-03.material:
Kafin tafiya ƙasar waje, kana son canza 1,000,000 won zuwa dalolin Amurka. Darajar sayen kuɗin hannu a yau a ofisoshin canjin kuɗi biyu tana kamar haka.
Ofishin canji A: dalar 1 = 1,400 won, babu kuɗin hidima.
Ofishin canji B: dalar 1 = 1,380 won, an bayyana kuɗin hidima kawai da cewa “ana gudanar da talla ta musamman”, ba tare da bayar da adadi ba.
Kana son yanke shawarar wanne ne zai ba ka daloli masu yawa.
x-m-el-econ-03.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ko bayanin da ake da shi ya wadatar
x-m-el-econ-03.thinking.1: Bambance bayanin da ake buƙata da wanda ba a buƙata ba
x-m-el-econ-03.thinking.2: Nemo iyakar da sakamakon yake sauyawa
x-m-el-econ-03.prereq.0: Ma’anar darajar canjin kuɗi (won ga kowace dala)
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanan da suke da muhimmanci ƙwarai wajen yanke hukuncin ofishin da zai ba da daloli masu yawa.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane bayani, ka tambayi kanka ko saninsa zai iya sauya adadin dalolin da ofisoshin biyu za su bayar.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ka riƙe lambobin da ke ƙayyade adadin dalolin da za ka samu kawai.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.o.a: Adadin kuɗin hidimar ofishin canji na 나
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.r.a: Ka gano lambar da ba ta cikin kwatancen.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.o.b: Lokacin buɗewa da wurin gine-ginen ofisoshin canjin kuɗi biyu
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.r.b: Wannan bayani ne na yau da kullum wanda ba ya da alaƙa kai tsaye da canjin kuɗi. Tantance ko wani bayani ne da yake sauya adadin dalolin da za a samu.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.o.c: Ko ana ɗaukar kuɗin hidimar ofishin canji na 나 a matsayin kaso na kuɗin da aka canza ko kuma tsayayyen adadi
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.r.c: Kana buƙatar sanin hanyar ɗaukar kuɗin hidima don lissafa adadin dalolin da za ka karɓa a zahiri. Ka gano bayanin da ake buƙata tare da adadin kuɗin hidimar.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.o.d: Hasashen ko darajar canjin kuɗi za ta tashi ko ta faɗi a wata mai zuwa
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.r.d: Tambayar wane ofishi ne ya fi bayarwa a yau ba ta buƙatar hasashen gaba. Ka yi tunanin inda lambobin kwatancen suka fito.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.o.e: Tsarin kasafin kuɗin kashewa yayin tafiya
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.r.e: Sanin adadin kuɗin da kake buƙata ya bambanta da yanke shawarar wanne ofishi ne zai fi bayarwa.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.explain: Idan ba ka san adadin kuɗin hidima da yadda ake ɗaukarsa ba, ba za ka iya lissafa adadin dalolin da ofishin canji na 나 zai bayar a zahiri ba. An riga an bayar da tushen darajar canjin kuɗin biyun a sanarwar (na yau, sayen kuɗin hannu). Ba a amfani da hasashen gaba, lokutan buɗewa ko tsarin kasafin kuɗi wajen kwatancen yau.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.prompt: A ce adadin kuɗin hidimar ofishin B f% ne, kuma saboda kuɗin hidimar adadin da ake biya ga kowace dala ya zama 1,380 × (1 + f/100) won. Shigar da ƙimomi daban-daban guda 2 na f da za su sa ofishin B ya ba da daloli masu yawa fiye da A. (f yana tsakanin 0 da 10, ciki har da iyakokin, da wuri ɗaya na desimal)
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kwatanta kuɗin sayen dala 1 a ofishin A da na ofishin B.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada wasu ƙimomi na f, ka lissafa ko 1,380 × (1 + f/100) ya yi ƙasa da 1,400.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Yana tsakanin 0 da 10, da wuri ɗaya na desimal.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole f ya kasance tsakanin 0 da 10, ciki har da iyakokin, kuma a rubuta shi da wuri ɗaya na desimal kawai.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Adadin da ake biya ga kowace dala bai kai 1,400 won ba.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Adadin da ake biya ga kowace dala ya kai 1,400 won ko ya fi haka, saboda haka ofishin B ba ya bayar da daloli masu yawa.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.explain: Idan adadin da ake biya ga kowace dala bai kai 1,400 won ba, za ka samu daloli masu yawa daga 1,000,000 won ɗin. Tun da 1,380 × 1.0145 ≈ 1,400, iyakar tana kusan 1.45%. Idan aka yi amfani da wuri ɗaya na desimal, 1.4% ko ƙasa da haka ya cancanta.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Bisa ƙimomin da ka samu, rubuta kusan daga wane kaso na kuɗin hidima a ofishin B ya kamata a yi gargaɗi cewa idan ya wuce wannan, ofishin A ya fi kyau.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta farashin dala ɗaya da zai yi daidai da na ofishin A.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Duba abin da za ka samu idan ka raba wannan farashi da 1,380.

x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan kashin kuɗin hidima ya wuce kusan 1.4%, ofishin A ya fi kyau. Domin ƙara 1.45% a kan 1,380 won yana ba da kusan 1,400 won.

x-m-el-econ-05.title: Ina Farashi Ke Daina Tashi da Faduwa?
x-m-el-econ-05.goal: Duba a hankali yawan da ake buƙata da wanda ake samarwa a kowane farashi, kimanta farashin daidaito, sannan ka yanke hukunci kan abin da ke faruwa idan an sa iyakar farashi.
x-m-el-econ-05.material: Adadin akwatunan da mutane ke son saya kowace rana (yawan buƙata) da adadin da suke son sayarwa (yawan wadata) na lemu a kasuwa suna sauyawa da farashin akwati. Ana bayyana bayanan farashi ɗaya bayan ɗaya.

x-m-el-econ-05.prereq.0: Ma'anar yawan buƙata (adadin da mutane ke son saya) da yawan wadata (adadin da suke son sayarwa)
x-m-el-econ-05.prereq.1: Nemo ƙa'ida a tebur (ƙaruwa da raguwa da adadi tsayayye)
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi ra'ayin yadda farashi zai motsa.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko ka kwatanta a kowane farashi wanne ya fi yawa: adadin da mutane ke son saya ko wanda suke son sayarwa.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.hint.1: Wurin da ɓangaren da ya fi yawa ke sauyawa yana nuna inda farashin daidaito yake.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.info: A farashin 10,000원: masu saya suna son akwatuna 90, masu sayarwa suna son 30.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan wannan farashin ya ci gaba haka, me ake tsammanin zai faru?
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.after: A 10,000원, yawan buƙata (90) ya fi yawan wadata (30) sosai. Mutane da yawa ba za su iya saya ba, saboda haka farashi zai iya tashi.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: An kawo sayarwa fiye da abin da ake so, saboda haka akwatuna za su rage kuma farashi zai faɗi.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Sake duba wanne ya fi yawa, buƙata ko wadata. Ka karanta alkiblar lambobin teburin akasin yadda ya kamata.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ana son abu fiye da wanda aka kawo, saboda haka wasu ba za su iya saya ba kuma akwai matsin lamba na ƙarin farashi.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka nuna daidai abin da ke faruwa idan yawan buƙata ya fi yawan wadata.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ko da adadin saya da sayarwa sun bambanta, farashi ba ya canzawa.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Idan adadin bai yi daidai ba, ko masu saya ko masu sayarwa ba za su gamsu ba. Ka yi tunanin abin da zai biyo baya.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za a iya yanke hukunci da bayanan farashi guda ɗaya kawai ba.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ko da farashi guda ɗaya ne, kwatanta buƙata da wadata yana ba ka damar faɗin hanyar da farashi zai bi.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Lokacin da farashi ya zama 20,000원: masu saya suna son akwatuna 70, masu sayarwa suna son 50.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kusan wane farashi ne adadin da ake son saya da wanda ake son sayarwa za su daidaita (farashin daidaito)?
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.after: A 20,000원 ma 70 > 50 ne, saboda haka har yanzu ana son fiye da abin da aka kawo. Farashin daidaito ya fi 20,000원.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: A farashin biyun adadin da ake so ya fi yawa. Ka yi tunanin ko farashi zai tashi ko ya faɗi idan abin da ake so ya fi yawa.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ko a 20,000원, buƙata 70 ce, wadata kuma 50 ce, don haka ba su daidaita ba tukuna.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ko a 20,000원, buƙata har yanzu ta fi yawa, saboda haka farashi na bukatar ƙarin tashi. Hukuncin ya dace da bayanan.

x-m-el-econ-10.thinking.2: Karyata da lambobi sannan ka bayyana sharuddan

x-m-el-econ-10.s.s1.r.a: Ba a ambaci haraji a cikin bayanin matsalar ba. Yi aiki da lambobin da aka bayar kawai (3% da 4%).
x-m-el-econ-10.s.s1.o.b: Wannan daidai ne. Adadin ya ƙaru, saboda haka babu asara a kowane hali

x-m-el-econ-10.s.s1.o.c: Adadin ya ƙaru, amma yawan kayan iri ɗaya da za a iya saya ya ragu, saboda haka asara ce
x-m-el-econ-10.s.s1.r.c: Ka bambance adadi da ikon saye. Ka yi amfani da bayanin farashi a hukuncinka.
x-m-el-econ-10.s.s1.o.d: Farashi ba shi da alaƙa da ajiya, saboda haka ba za a iya sanin ko riba ce ko asara ba
x-m-el-econ-10.s.s1.r.d: Idan ka yi tunanin amfani da kuɗin ajiyar wajen sayen kaya daga baya, farashi yana da muhimmanci.
